minecraft:written_book_content.title: A Prayer Without a Name
minecraft:written_book_content.author: Unknown
pages: {"text":"We were told not to speak the name aloud. The stones were arranged before we arrived."}
{"text":"At dusk the shadows pointed toward the forest, even when the sun was behind us."}

{"text":"A mark is repeated in every hidden lower chamber: three short strokes around an empty center. The station map ends at a blank square. The mapmaker drew this mark there, then crossed out every route leading north."}
